About

Results-driven, five years into logistics and B2B sales.

I am a logistics and supply chain professional with 5+ years of experience across freight forwarding, customs clearance, commercial logistics, transportation, and B2B freight solutions in the UAE and GCC.

Currently with Aramex Abu Dhabi, I work across air, sea and land freight solutions, supporting businesses with commercial shipments, cross-border transportation, warehousing and integrated logistics requirements. My experience combines strong customer understanding with practical knowledge of freight routing, documentation, customs coordination, shipment planning, cost evaluation and delivery execution.

My focus is on understanding the complete movement of cargo — from shipper and origin through freight transportation, customs and border procedures to the final customer — while maintaining the right balance between cost, transit time, reliability and operational efficiency.

End-to-End Logistics
Expertise

My experience covers:

Practical Supply Chain Approach

Every shipment has different requirements. I approach logistics by evaluating the cargo, origin, destination, urgency, transportation mode, customs requirements, documentation and total landed cost before determining the most practical solution.

My approach is simple
01Understand the requirement
02Plan the route
03Select the right mode
04Coordinate documentation
05Manage customs
06Execute transportation
07Monitor delivery

For complex or time-sensitive movements, I also focus on alternative routes and multimodal solutions, particularly where geopolitical developments, border restrictions, capacity constraints or changing trade conditions affect conventional freight routes.

Cross-Border & International Freight

I have exposure to freight movements connecting the UAE/GCC with Europe, Turkey, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Southeast Asia, covering different transportation modes and shipment requirements.

This includes coordinating solutions for road freight, sea freight, air freight and integrated door-to-door movements, with attention to customs, documentation, transit time and overall logistics cost.

Beyond Freight Sales

My experience in business development has strengthened my understanding of how companies actually use logistics — their production schedules, inventory requirements, delivery commitments, freight budgets and operational challenges.

This commercial understanding complements my freight and logistics knowledge, allowing me to look at shipments from both the business and operational perspective.

The objective is always to create logistics solutions that are
Cost-effective Seamless Reliable Compliant Operationally Practical

Customs & trade facilitation

Keeping shipments compliant, on time, and out of demurrage.

  • Customs clearance coordination
  • Import, export & re-export procedures
  • Break bulk & RoRo vessel clearance
  • Import permits — FANAR, MOHAP, MOCCAE, MOI
  • Customs & trade portals — ATLP, Dubai Trade
  • DG cargo clearance & delivery
  • Landed-cost & documentation review
  • Shipment tracking & issue resolution

Actual eligibility, approvals and customs treatment depend on applicable regulations and shipment-specific requirements.
